hero.title: Virtual Training Programs for Imam University Students – In Partnership with OTAS
hero.paragraph_1: Launch your professional future with the first fully virtual cooperative training program in the tourism and digital technology sector!
hero.paragraph_2: Through a strategic partnership between Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University and OTAS, the leading travel technology platform, we are opening the doors to an exceptional training experience.
hero.paragraph_3: This is not just a set of training hours – it is an intensive hands-on journey through advanced operating systems, big data analytics, content management, digital compliance, financial technology (FinTech), and artificial intelligence – all delivered via interactive training platforms that mirror real-world working environments.
hero.paragraph_4: You will gain modern operational skills that are in high demand in today's market, and you will become part of Saudi Vision 2030's commitment to empowering young national talent. Whether you are a male or female student, this is your opportunity to acquire competitive practical experience, build a professional network, and add real value to your CV – all from the comfort of your own space, at your own pace.
hero.quote: Don't wait for an opportunity like this to come around again. Register now and become one of the changemakers in the digital tourism sector.
hero.note: The programs run entirely virtually on advanced digital training platforms, giving students hands-on training in travel operating systems, data, content, compliance, financial technology and artificial intelligence.

about.title: About the agreement
about.intro: A cooperation agreement has been signed between Imam University and OTAS Platform with the following objectives:
about.goal_1: Enhancing cooperative training for students and preparing them for the labour market
about.goal_2: Developing advanced and specialised digital educational programs in the tourism sector
about.goal_3: Exchanging academic, practical and technical expertise between both parties
about.goal_4: Supporting the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 in digital transformation and capacity development
about.goal_5: Conducting joint scientific research and developing smart technology solutions that serve the community
about.note_financial_title: This agreement is non-financial and serves as a general framework for cooperation
about.note_financial_body: “It does not entail or imply any financial or legal obligation.”
about.note_privacy_body: “Both parties undertake to maintain the confidentiality of information and to comply with the university’s cybersecurity requirements.”

programs.title: The seven training programs
programs.subtitle: Specialised programs that combine technology and tourism to qualify future professionals. All programs are designed according to the highest joint academic and technical standards.
programs.traveltech_text: A technical program introducing students to modern travel operating platforms such as OTAS.NET, supplier management, no-code travel website building, and understanding technical integrations via APIs.
programs.media_text: A program focused on producing textual and visual tourism content, writing travel guides, and creating creative content through AI.
programs.languages_title: Languages and international customer service program
programs.languages_text: A specialised program in travel translation, multilingual content, international communication, and professional complaint management.
programs.compliance_text: A program focused on regulatory compliance, tourism contracts, international regulations, and legal risk management in the travel sector.
programs.fintech_text: A specialised program in digital wallets, settlements, electronic payments, and financial risk management in the travel sector.
programs.ai_text: A program focused on building intelligent autonomous systems, recommendation engines, dynamic pricing, and the Travel AI Agent.
programs.data_text: A program training participants in booking data analysis, building dashboards, reading performance indicators, and feeding AI models.
programs.trust: Registration is free and requires no prior financial commitments.

international.title: Programs tailored to international students
international.visual_title: The global gateway to digital tourism education
international.visual_text: We connect you to your professional future, wherever you are
international.intro_lead: Imam University and OTAS Platform welcome international students interested in joining the virtual training programs in the tourism and digital technology sector.
international.intro_sub: All programs are delivered in Arabic, with the option to provide an English version upon request.
international.global_content_text: Curricula designed to align with the standards and requirements of the international tourism job market.
international.fully_virtual_text: Attend lectures and interactive workshops from anywhere in the world with complete flexibility.
international.certificates_text: Professional certificates issued jointly by OTAS Platform and the IFITT-MENA federation.
international.language_support_text: Training materials delivered in Arabic, with key terms and references also provided in English.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.answer_1: Yes, the programs are completely free for Imam University students as part of the cooperation agreement.
faq.answer_2: Yes, all programs are delivered remotely via digital training platforms.
faq.answer_3: Yes, trainees will receive a certificate accredited by both OTAS Platform and Imam University.
faq.question_4: Can students register for more than one program?
faq.answer_4: Yes, students may register for a maximum of two programs per semester.
